projects.name: NeuroWeave
projects.summary: Deep learning for connectome analysis and neurological recovery prediction. Published as ReMind at IEEE ICIETSD 2026.
projects.problem: Explore how MRI data and brain connectivity analysis can support research into neurological recovery after stroke and traumatic brain injury.
contributions: PyTorch models and neurological data preprocessing
Asynchronous FastAPI endpoints for secure data ingestion and concurrent inference
projects.approach: The project connects neurological data preprocessing and deep learning analysis with a Python API layer. PyTorch supports the modelling work, while asynchronous FastAPI endpoints expose the analysis workflow.
projects.engineering: The engineering work spans two connected concerns: preparing neurological data for modelling, and exposing inference through an asynchronous backend. Docker is part of the documented development stack.
projects.outcome: Published as ReMind at IEEE ICIETSD 2026. The ReMind team also won third prize at the ELYSIA Project Competition.

paper.title: ReMind: Connectome Analysis for Predicting Neurological Recovery
paper.description: Connectome analysis and deep learning for neurological recovery prediction using MRI data.

projects.name: StellarisAI
projects.summary: An AI-powered smart hiring system combining LLaMA 3.2, retrieval-augmented generation, and NLP for context-aware candidate evaluation.
projects.problem: Bring relevant candidate information into an AI-assisted hiring workflow so evaluations can use retrieved context alongside language-model responses.
contributions: RAG pipelines and prompt engineering for candidate evaluation
Flask REST APIs for real-time recruitment workflows
projects.approach: StellarisAI combines retrieval-augmented generation, NLP, and LLaMA 3.2 for candidate evaluation. Flask REST APIs connect these capabilities to the recruitment workflow.
projects.engineering: The technical focus is connecting retrieved context with a language model, then making that workflow usable through backend APIs. The project brings prompt engineering and application development into the same system.
projects.outcome: The team project became Stellaris AI: Personalized AI for Smart Hiring, published at IEEE ICCPCT 2025. Anjana is the second author.
